name: DepMap (Cancer Dependency Map)

version.value: Not retrieved: the portal presented a human-verification page to automated clients

scope: Genome-scale CRISPR knockout and RNAi dependency screens across cancer cell lines, with expression and mutation context.
mapping_methods: Gene-level scores per cell line; join on gene symbol/Entrez ID.

quantitative.summary: Gene effect scores (negative = dependency) per cell line.

licence.name: Terms page not readable (verification wall); commonly CC BY 4.0

coverage_limitations: Cancer cell lines only; essentiality in culture does not equal organismal or human-germline effect
Portal states bulk data should be taken from its downloads section, not scraped
known_omissions: Figshare search did not return DepMap Public release records

reuse_decision.rationale: Open Targets 26.09 carries a target_essentiality (DepMap) dataset and CRISPR screen evidence; use that. Direct download needs the user to fetch from the DepMap downloads page manually.

status.notes: Automated access met a human-verification page; not bypassed.
